fixture_conventions.players: P is acting player; Q and R are other players unless a case says otherwise.
fixture_conventions.ready: Fully unused actual movement and primary action; native follow-ups tracked independently.
fixture_conventions.actual_vs_apparent: An actual/apparent pair is independent unless explicitly normal/unmasked.
fixture_conventions.native: Values/eligibility from the pinned build adapter, not invented constants. Native upgrade timing is measured before sequence assertions.
fixture_conventions.observations: Every case requires both authoritative-state checks and viewpoint-filtered presentation checks.
fixture_conventions.coordinates: Straight-line examples use native distance; do not assume Euclidean geometry or undocumented diagonal rules.
fixture_conventions.reset: Alternative branches named in one case begin from identical reset fixtures; do not grant in-match action refreshes to run alternatives.
fixture_conventions.scope: A source form in a fixture must have a tested adapter. Missing adapter is NOT IMPLEMENTED, not PASS.
